review_method: GitHub connector read-only; branch-file blob identities rechecked at pinned commit; no remote writes; no model inference or training run in this review.
verified: Runtime is sherpa-onnx 1.12.40 CPU streaming transducer wrapper, configured feature_dim=80.
Mature decoder uses mixed INT8 encoder/joiner and FP32 decoder, 160 ms input delivery, 0.66 s tail padding, endpoint detection disabled.
Each decode creates one stream reused for all chunks; native token/log-probability/timestamp lists are checked for equal lengths.
V1 trains candidate improvement classifiers, not the pretrained acoustic model.
V2 proposal_features returns 17 features without reference text; fit_acceptor weights changed proposals equally per sentence.
V3 gate trains a 12-feature logistic predictor of normalized hypothesis change, not improvement; policy lazily calls second decoder zero or one times.
V3 report has 39 sentences, 1683 reference characters: V2 326 errors and 39 second-pass calls; primary 327 errors and 13 calls; legacy and rule cascades also 327 errors with 4 and 8 calls.
V3 report's 31.45% compute saving is an offline estimate using cached single decode timings, not microphone latency.

Full read: metrics.py, run_experiment.py, mature/decoder.py, mature/ALGORITHM.md, mature_v3/gate.py, mature_v3/policy.py, three published reports; relevant feature/training/prediction portions of mature_v2/acceptor.py.
